content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Los Angeles

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your education and professional background meet these thresholds before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our synchronous format keeps you engaged with active certified practitioners while accommodating Los Angeles professionals' schedules. You'll cover all five process groups and PMBOK® Guide domains in a structured, accelerated curriculum.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours with Granite PM Academy, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include proof of your education and project-management experience, pay the exam fee, and await PMI's eligibility review before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and guidance to reinforce bootcamp concepts. You'll sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Within that cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or PMI membership activities. Plan your PDU strategy early to ensure timely renewal and sustained career advantage.
